item.title: Paul Keels to Be Inducted Into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame
item.description: The “Voice of the Buckeyes” will be inducted into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame this June. Paul Keels is one of 14 men and women in the 2026 induction class, a group comprising former players, coaches, officials, and administrators. He is the lone broadcaster in the group. Keels has called Ohio State football and men’s basketball games since 1998. item.title: John Mobley Jr. Heats Back Up When Ohio State Needed It Most Against Purdue
item.description: Winter seemed to thaw temporarily this week across the state of Ohio, with temperatures peaking in the 60s after a harsh January and February. Warmer air around the Schottenstein Center foretold the return of a dormant hot hand in Ohio State’s time of need. John Mobley Jr. missed three 3-point attempts early, then went Human Torch mode with a 5-of-8 mark from 3-point land and 21 total points in the final 32 minutes of play. item.title: Jaloni Cambridge Earns Unanimous First-Team All-Big Ten Honors, Kennedy Cambridge and Elsa Lemmilä Make All-Defensive Team
item.description: Jaloni Cambridge is one of four unanimous first-team All-Big Ten selections this season. Ohio State’s star sophomore point guard earns first-team All-Big Ten honors for the second year in a row. She led the conference with 23.4 points per game during the regular season and also averaged 5.6 rebounds, 4.5 assists and 1.9 steals per game, leading Ohio State to a 24-6 record.
